title: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Innistrad province of rolling farmlands surrounded by dense woods that hide werewolves, ghosts and other menaces.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane on which Kessig and its neighboring provinces lie.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Dense, misty forest bordering Kessig, haunted by werewolves and spirits.

entities.name: Kessigers
entities.description: Hardworking, pragmatic farming people of Kessig.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel worshipped on Innistrad, who has gone missing and whose protective magic is waning.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Religion of Avacyn, which keeps the truth of her disappearance from Innistrad's denizens.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The High City where blessed silver amulets are crafted and decrees originate.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Innistrad province whose relations with Kessig have worsened.

entities.name: Curfew of Silver
entities.description: Decree requiring Kessig commoners out after dark to wear a blessed silver amulet.

entities.name: Sleep Revel
entities.description: Kessig ceremony celebrating a person's life on the anniversary of death.

entities.name: Mondronen
entities.description: Howlpack of about sixty werewolves said to control dark, bloody nature magic; led by Tovolar.

entities.name: Leeraug
entities.description: Small, tight-knit howlpack that hunts under the new moon; led by Skaharra.

entities.name: Krallenhorde
entities.description: Innistrad's largest howlpack, mixing repentant and wanton werewolves; led by Ulrich.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Mute, silver-furred alpha of the Mondronen who never seems to revert to human form.

entities.name: Skaharra
entities.description: Black-furred she-wolf alpha of the Leeraug who kills along bloodlines.

entities.name: Ulrich
entities.description: Cunning, perceptive wanton werewolf who is alpha of the Krallenhorde.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Farming village in Kessig terrorized by werewolves.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: Ruined former county seat of Kessig, once the town of Avabruck, leveled by a Mondronen blood ritual.

entities.name: Temple of Saint Raban
entities.description: Avabruck's central cathedral, whose wards failed and which the Mondronen tore down.

entities.name: Devils' Breach
entities.description: Smoking fissure in the hills at the edge of Kessig, threatening demonic activity.

entities.name: Hairpin Road
entities.description: Road in Kessig along which elegant vampire coaches occasionally travel.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: Respected astronomancer who posited that Innistrad's moon is a desert of tiny silver grains.

entities.name: Theodora Glick
entities.description: Alchemist who came closest to curing lycanthropy by forcing Guthril to remain human for three lunar cycles.

entities.name: Guthril
entities.description: Captured werewolf who reverted for three lunar cycles, then re-emerged stronger and destroyed Glick's laboratory.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Duality-bound monsters who are both man and wolf, tied to the moon.

entities.name: Lycanthropy
entities.description: Supernatural curse that mingles a victim's spirit with the wild essence of nature, symbolized by the wolf.

entities.name: Geists
entities.description: Wild spirits of nature in Kessig that taunt and terrorize civilized life.

events.summary: Avacyn goes missing, and the church at Thraben conceals the truth while werewolf attacks and hauntings increase.
events.quote: Ever since Avacyn went missing last year, the church at Thraben has kept the truth of her disappearance from Innistrad's denizens.

events.summary: The Curfew of Silver decree requires blessed silver amulets for Kessig commoners after dark; relations with Gavony worsen.
events.quote: Since the Curfew of Silver, relations between Kessig and Gavony have worsened.

events.summary: With Avacynian magic waning, the wards around Avabruck's cathedral fail and the Mondronen discover the breach.
events.quote: It took only two nights for the werewolves to discover this breach in protection.

events.summary: The Mondronen rip through Avabruck, slaughter its people and besiege and tear down the cathedral.
events.quote: The howlpack known as Mondronen ripped through the town, slaughtering any in their path, charging straight for the Temple.

events.summary: A werewolf blood ritual levels Avabruck from the center out, killing hundreds and creating Hollowhenge.
events.quote: A mystical, concussive force leveled the city from the center out, flattening most of the structures in town and killing hundreds.

events.summary: The ruined city is abandoned, even by the howlpack, and left to ghosts and scavengers.
events.quote: As time went on, the city was abandoned, even by the howlpack.

events.summary: Alchemist Theodora Glick forces the captured Guthril to stay human for three lunar cycles, but he re-emerges and destroys her laboratory in Gavony.
events.quote: He utterly destroyed Glick's laboratory in Gavony and fled into the night.

relations.quote: Their alpha Tovolar is a mute, silver-furred werewolf
The Leeraug alpha is Skaharra, a black-furred she-wolf
The alpha of Krallenhorde is currently the werewolf Ulrich

relations.note: Guthril destroyed her laboratory after her ritual wore off
relations.quote: Unfortunately, the ritual was only temporary, and Guthril re-emerged stronger than ever.
A ruin of wood and brick now stands where Kessig's county seat stood.

relations.note: Fissure at the edge of the province
relations.quote: a smoking fissure called Devils' Breach lies in the tall stone hills at the edge of the province
